note: OCG Standard §25 ocg-private-input@1. policy_parameters carries ONLY the two sha256-salted@1 commitments (reserves, outstanding) plus public unit/as_of/citation, never a reserve or outstanding amount. All figures are synthetic. Disclosure material lives OUT-OF-BAND in art-809-check-reserves-cover-outstanding-private.disclosure.json (test-only). human_sign_off: PENDING.

vectors.name: full_16_slots_cover_with_margin
vectors.description: Sixteen slots across all eight categories, total reserves 10,000,000,000,000 minor units against 9,990,000,000,000 outstanding. Covered.

policy_parameters.citation: GENIUS Act (Pub. L. 119-27) section 4(a)(1)(A): reserves backing outstanding payment stablecoins on an at least 1 to 1 basis, in the reserve categories listed in (i) to (viii).

output_payload.basis: Shows that the committed reserve amounts, in the categories the GENIUS Act lists, add up to at least the committed amount outstanding. It does not show the reserves exist, are unencumbered, or are approved where approval is required, and it does not replace the monthly report the Act requires.
output_payload.privacy_note: The verdict is public. The inputs are not in the receipt. A receipt made from inputs you gave a server was seen by that server. Each receipt answers one yes/no question; asking many questions about the same figures reveals more.
output_payload.not_legal_advice: Not legal or regulatory advice. Reserve adequacy determinations require review by the issuer's qualified finance and compliance staff and the applicable regulator.
